description: Use this when someone asks about price quotes given to salon clients, such as which are pending, approved or rejected. Returns quotes with id, client and salon ids, status and date for all salons unless one is given, newest first, up to 100; the status filter applies within that page. Not for quote amounts or line items.

clientId.description: Only quotes for this client, by an id from the client list

endTime.description: Only quotes ending before this ISO 8601 time

limit.description: Maximum number of quotes to return (default 20, maximum 100)

salonId.description: Only quotes from this salon, by an id from the user's salon list; every salon when absent

startTime.description: Only quotes starting at or after this ISO 8601 time

status.description: Only quotes with this status: DRAFT, PENDING, REJECTED or APPROVED. Applied within the fetched page of newest quotes

name: list_quotes

quotes.description: Quotes, newest first. Free-text notes, quoted line details and amounts, discounts, contact details and organization data are excluded.

title: List client quotes
